exposure.needed: whether the operator runs `flux create tenant` and wants a custom service-account name; operator CLI usage is not carried in manifests, values, or workload configuration

consequence.statement: Purely additive CLI capability: the evidence states no removal, changed default, or failure, so an operator who does nothing sees no stated operational change.

assertion.statement: Flux 2.7.0 makes the service-account name configurable in the `flux create tenant` CLI command (an added capability); the release note names no specific flag and states no change to existing behavior.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: the evidence names the command (`flux create tenant`) but not the new option/flag itself, so a cli-flag identity cannot be spelled without inventing the flag name
